data.name: Eswaran
data.gender_notes: Eswaran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eswaran is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Eshwara', which means 'Lord of the Universe'. In Hindu mythology, Eshwara is a form of Shiva, the God of destruction and regeneration. This name is often given to a child born on a Tuesday, as Tuesday is considered a lucky day for Shiva devotees. The name Eswaran carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eswaran usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eswaran belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eswaran total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
